description: This file contains functions for listing model parameters in a PyTorch JIT module, including traversing submodules, extracting attributes, and modifying the computation graph for ONNX export.

methods.name: findSubModuleAttr
methods.description: Traverses getAttr chains backwards to locate submodules within a module.

methods.name: addParamAsArgument
methods.description: Adds a parameter as an argument to a function and updates its schema.

methods.name: getParamAttributes
methods.description: Extracts parameter attributes from a graph block, handling nested blocks and various attribute types.

methods.name: insertMainModuleAsConstant
methods.description: Inserts the main module as a constant object into the graph.

methods.name: list_module_parameters
methods.description: Main function that clones a module, extracts its parameters, and modifies the graph for ONNX export.
